question: Why is conceptual construction given primacy in this context?
premises: The fruit of awareness should not be divided into different results.
The teaching emphasizes conceptual construction in this context.
That emphasis serves the path toward the non-conceptual culmination.
inference: Conceptual construction is treated as primary here because it leads to the same undivided fruit of awareness.
plain_english: Here one should not imagine any division in the fruit of awareness. For that reason, the primacy of conceptual construction in this very context was indicated.
